import random,copy
from differential import topo,cert,apply,runcheck
for seed in range(5):
 r=random.Random(seed+500);n,tm=topo(['torus2d',4,'row']);g=30;d=150
 s={'topology':['torus2d',4,'row'],'caps':[10**9]*n,'groups':[[64,10**12] for _ in range(g)],'tasks':[[r.randrange(60),r.randrange(g),r.randrange(1,10**9),0,0] for _ in range(d)],'query':{'groups':list(range(g)),'nodes':list(range(n)),'tasks':list(range(d))},'transactions':[]}
 # all template IDs <60 have source0..3 and source row0 domain.
 ss=copy.deepcopy(s);out={'nodes':n,'templates':len(tm),'initial':cert(s,tm,s['query']),'transactions':[]};rev=0;ac=0
 for j in range(1200):
  edits=[]
  for _ in range(r.randrange(0,15)):
   op=r.choice(['move','bind','weight','class','pin','quota','budget','cap'])
   i=r.randrange(d if op in ['move','bind','weight','class','pin'] else g if op in ['quota','budget'] else n)
   v=r.randrange(g) if op=='move' else r.randrange(60) if op=='bind' else r.randrange(1,10**9) if op=='weight' else r.randrange(2) if op in ['class','pin'] else r.randrange(65) if op=='quota' else 10**12 if op=='budget' else r.choice([0,10**9])
   edits.append([op,i,v])
  if j%17==0:
   edits=[['pin',i,0] for i in range(d)]+[['class',i,0] for i in range(d)]+[['quota',i,64] for i in range(g)]+[['cap',i,10**9] for i in range(n)]
  q={'groups':[r.randrange(g) for _ in range(4)],'nodes':list(range(n)),'tasks':[r.randrange(d) for _ in range(10)]}
  tx={'revision':rev,'edits':edits,'query':q};s['transactions'].append(tx);ss,o=apply(ss,tm,tx,rev);rev=o['revision'];ac+=o['accepted'];out['transactions'].append(o)
 runcheck({'version':2,'sessions':[s]},{'sessions':[out]})
 print('Accepted-state fuzz batch',seed,'accepted',ac,'of 1200: exact match')
PY
